name: Lucy, Hell Puppy
text: Lucy is a breach-warmed puppy with ember paws, blue innocent eyes, and a bite that leaves little red stars in armor plate. Once per round, use Lucy to record an ember-pup note before battle, damage, or a dangerous movement choice.

activeEffect.text: Lucy barks fire into the ash: record an ember-pup note for this battle, damage, or route choice.

acquisition: Drawn from the Artifact deck as a legendary companion bond.
Awarded by an ember shrine, rescue event, or firebreak route.
Recovered after clearing a burning sector without taking a wound.
flavor: She has never met a battlefield she could not improve by wagging at it.
imagePrompt: A grimdark fantasy-sci-fi companion card showing a tiny fluffy hell puppy with blue eyes, ember-red horn sparks, glowing fire paws, a black spiked collar with a red ward charm, walking through burning basalt ruins and gothic-industrial ash. Cute but supernatural, fiery tail glow, dark red skies, cinematic Ashen Reach card art, no text.
